metadata.title: Electronic Dance Music DJ Mix Cover

recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure wearing a white cylindrical bucket mask with a black cutout smiley face, positioned against a vibrant background of glowing orange concentric circles. The figure wears a dark teal and maroon varsity jacket. Large, stylized orange typography sits behind the head, while secondary white text is positioned at the corners.
coreVisualRelationships: The white mask acts as a high-contrast focal point against the warm orange background.
The large orange background text is layered behind the central figure but in front of the circular patterns.
The teal jacket provides a cool-toned anchor to the otherwise warm-dominated color palette.
Concentric rings create a sense of motion and depth radiating from the center.
coreInvariants: Cylindrical white mask with black 'X' eyes and curved smile
High-contrast layering of text and subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, head tilted slightly to the right, occupying the middle vertical third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white mask with black features provides the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the white mask, move outward along the concentric circles, then to the large background text, and finally to the corner metadata.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with light effects and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant Orange (Background light and large text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background glows contrasted with the matte white and dark fabric textures.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'i' with a perfectly circular dot
Letters like 'm' and 'n' have uniform arch widths
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large stylized display face paired with clean, functional geometric sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Layered depth (Background > Text > Subject > Overlay Text)

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded, geometric feel of the display text.
Suitable for the clean metadata text in the corners.
Alternative for display text with rounded terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a background of glowing orange and red concentric circles with a central figure from the chest up wearing a dark teal varsity jacket and a white cylindrical bucket mask with a black smiley face. Leave space for large text behind the head.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, rounded orange sans-serif text behind the mask. Add clean white sans-serif metadata text in the top left, top right, and bottom left corners.

verificationChecks: Is the mask pure white with high contrast black features?
Are the background circles glowing and concentric?
Is the display text layered behind the subject's head?
Is the color palette strictly orange, teal, white, and dark red?

mustRedesign: Exact facial feature proportions of the mask
postGenerationChecks: Verify text is legible against the glowing background.
Ensure the mask remains the brightest element in the composition.
Check that the layering of text behind the subject is clean.
Confirm the circular light trails are centered on the subject.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast masked subject with concentric radial light effects and layered, heavy-weight rounded typography for a modern electronic music aesthetic.
